    • start

      public void start()
      Starts the guide flow by displaying the first guide in the queue. If no guides are present, it shows a message dialog. It attaches listeners to the current guide and builds its UI.

    • finished

      public boolean finished()
      Checks if all guides in the flow have been processed.
      Returns:
      true if there are no more guides to show, false otherwise.

    • indexOf

      Returns:
      The zero-based index of the guide, or -1 if the guide is not found.
